auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH race_853 AS (
    SELECT 
        r.XCL_065 AS race_id,
        r.XCL_067 AS round,
        r.XCL_070 AS race_date,
        res.XCL_082 AS fastest_lap_speed
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.XCL_065 = res.XCL_074
    JOIN drivers d ON res.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
    WHERE r.XCL_067 = 853
      AND d.XCL_035 = 'Paul'
      AND d.XCL_038 = 'di Resta'
),
next_race AS (
    SELECT 
        r.XCL_065 AS race_id,
        r.XCL_067 AS round,
        r.XCL_070 AS race_date,
        res.XCL_082 AS fastest_lap_speed
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.XCL_065 = res.XCL_074
    JOIN drivers d ON res.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
    WHERE r.XCL_067 = (SELECT MIN(XCL_067) FROM races WHERE XCL_067 > 853)
      AND d.XCL_035 = 'Paul'
      AND d.XCL_038 = 'di Resta'
)
SELECT 
    (nr.fastest_lap_speed - r853.fastest_lap_speed) * 100.0 / r853.fastest_lap_speed AS percent_faster
FROM race_853 r853
JOIN next_race nr ON 1=1
